hints.title: Guess Cost Optimization Perspective
hints.text: Every guess costs its face value. When anticipating that an adversary always forces the worst possible outcome, how can finding the best choice among worst-case paths guarantee minimal cost across any continuous range?

hints.title: Minimax Sub-interval Recurrence Invariant
hints.text: For interval [i, j], guessing k costs k plus the maximum of the optimal costs for left interval [i, k - 1] and right interval [k + 1, j].

hints.title: Interval Iteration and Transition Procedure
hints.text: Allocate a two-dimensional grid where dp[i][j] stores the minimax expense for range i to j. Base cases of length one cost zero. Iterate by increasing interval length from two up to n. For each span, evaluate every possible pivot k between i and j, picking the minimal worst-case sum. Return dp[1][n].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input size or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N^3) time and O(N^2) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every decision tree naively branches exponentially as O(n!).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval DP caches results for all sub-ranges in O(n^2) space, computing solutions in O(n^3) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize minimax game theory on contiguous sub-ranges and formulate the interval DP table.
